# Mathematical Reference {#sec-math-reference}

Only notation and results used repeatedly across the book belong here.

## Notation

- $x$: input or feature vector; $y$: target; $\theta$: model parameters.
- $\mathbb E[X]$: expectation; $\operatorname{Var}(X)$: variance; $\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)$: covariance.
- $p$ and $q$: probability distributions; $D$: observed dataset.

## Frequently used objectives

Negative log-likelihood, mean squared error, cross entropy, and KL divergence are introduced in [Chapter 1](../chapters/01-probability-statistics.qmd). Regularized objectives are introduced in [Chapter 2](../chapters/02-generalization-regularization.qmd).
